raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions does not normalize them. v2 rows are shifted forward about 6 hours, which pushes evening local transactions into 00:00-06:00 and onto the next calendar day, causing the 2026-01-19 volume drop and the early-morning distribution alerts. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago local wall-clock time in silver_transactions should correct txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
